items.title: Amazon is giving every US employee a discount on groceries
items.summary: All U.S. employees will receive 10% off eligible purchases online and 20% off in Whole Foods Market stores, with no cap on savings.

items.title: Amazon raises minimum starting pay for full-time core operations employees to $20/hour, with average pay reaching nearly $24/hour
items.summary: Amazon invests more than $1.5 billion in higher pay for U.S. core operations employees, alongside new benefits designed to help our teammate

items.title: What is the Amazon Influencer Program? Your questions answered.
items.summary: The program helps social media creators earn revenue by recommending products they love to their followers.
